chunks: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.
Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born. Nor is there to Him any equivalent.

key_terms.اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ: Allah, the Eternal Refuge / The Self-Sufficient
key_terms.لَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ: Nor is there to Him any equivalent

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning and significance of Surah Al-Ikhlas in Shia theology?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq utilizes this complete text of Surah Al-Ikhlas to anchor the doctrine of Tawhid within the broader framework of Imamate, often linking the purity of God's essence to the spiritual purity of the Imams. This chapter serves as a theological cornerstone in Shia scholarship, emphasizing not only monotheism but also the divine attributes that justify the authority of the Ahl al-Bayt as the perfect manifestations of God's will on earth.
